_README: REVIEWED value corrections for docs/sf_fundamentals.json cells (npStd/npCon).
NOT for scale errors -- those are scale_fix.json (power-of-ten, applied at PARSE time).
This ledger is for cells whose stored VALUE is simply wrong against the filing itself:
the wrong period, the wrong line, or a mis-transcription. Every entry states the primary
document and a SECOND independent document, because a single quote can be a typo and a
restatement looks exactly like an error until you check whether the later filing agrees.
Applied by scripts/apply_fund_cell_fix.py, guarded on `was` so it is idempotent and can
never overwrite a value someone else has since corrected. Measured 2026-08-23: pre-2016
cells in sf_fundamentals.json are NOT regenerated by the nightly (HINDUNILVR 20071231 held
473.79 unchanged across 40 commits), so a written correction persists; wiring this ledger
into build_fundamentals.py is still the durable follow-up for any era that IS rebuilt.

fixes.why: BSE ann 2007-10-31 12:48 (own-quarter filing): 'net profit of Rs 4080.60 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2007' = 408.06 cr. SECOND, independent: BSE ann 2008-10-24 12:37 (the Sep-2008 filing) repeats it as the comparative, 'as compared to Rs 4080.60 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2007'. Not a restatement -- both documents agree.

fixes.why: Supreme Petrochem std Q2FY18. THREE independent documents agree the PAT is 36.68, not 13.31: (1) OWN-QUARTER filing (BSE ann, 'Statement of Standalone Unaudited Results for the Quarter/Half Year Ended September 30, 2017'), col '2nd Quarter Ended on 30/09/2017': Profit after tax 3,667.84 lakhs = 36.68; (2) YEAR-LATER filing (Sep-2018), 'Corresponding Quarter ended in the Previous Year on 30/09/2017' col: 3,667.84 lakhs = 36.68; (3) Moneycontrol standalone pat_total for 20170930 = 36.68. NOT a restatement - both filing vintages and the aggregator all read 36.68. The filing has no minority-interest line, so 36.68 is both total and owners. Our stored 13.31 is an isolated transcription/parse error.
fixes.found: N500 std-revenue campaign 2026-08-24: the revStd fill for this cell could not anchor because the stored PAT was the broken value

fixes.why: Syngene std Q1FY16 — a PRE-LISTING quarter (first traded bar 2015-08-11; measured: BSE Result announcements for scrip 539268 START 2015-10-20, so no own Jun-2015 filing exists). AS-FILED 43.64 cr: the company's FIRST-EVER result filing (BSE ann 2015-10-20 19:14, CorpAttachment/2015/10/196A4865_E4EE_4EAD_9BF6_259895AF394F_191354.pdf, Rs in Lakhs), 'Preceding 3 months ended 30.06.2015' col Net profit 4,364; same page's H1 identity exact (9,593 = 4,364 + 5,229). FY16 identity: audited annual 2,212.0 mn (detres 89.50) minus the three filed quarters (522.9+588+665) = 436.1 mn. Moneycontrol std sc_id SI62 prints 43.60. The stored 46.6 is the IND-AS RESTATED comparative first published 2016-07-21 (Jun-2016 filing 'Corresponding 3 months 30.06.2015' = 466 mn) sitting on a 2015 ann date — a vintage look-ahead, NOT a restatement dispute: store convention is as-originally-filed (runbook §42 SHRIRAMFIN rule).
fixes.found: FAV14 MC adjudication handoff 2026-08-24 (flagged Sep-2015; whole-row heal per feedback-heal-the-row-not-the-cell)
